skill_score.update_formula: new = old + alpha * (outcome*100 - old); outcome in {0,1} (partial 0.5 for near-miss spelling)
skill_score.confidence: attempts >= 10 per skill; below that mark as provisional

placement_test.trigger: first launch or user requests 'find my level'
placement_test.format: adaptive, 20-30 items, no hints, mixed types (mcq, fa_to_en, en_to_fa, image_part_id, listening, fill_blank)
algorithm: Serve 3 items at current level (difficulty = level midpoint).
If >=2/3 correct move up one level; if 0/3 move down one; else stay and serve 3 more.
Stop when the level is stable for 2 rounds or 30 items are served.
Placement = highest level where accuracy >= 70% over its last 3+ items, minus 0 levels; cap at LVL-5 (higher levels require the exam).
Provide per-skill initial scores from item types.

term_srs.on_correct: box += 1 (box += 2 if answered within 50% of time limit and difficulty >= 3)
term_srs.on_wrong: box = max(0, box - 2); lapses += 1; state = 'lapsed' if box <= 1
reteach_protocol_fa: نمایش دوبارهٔ تصویر/تعریف و نمونه جمله

weakness_detection.by_category: category accuracy(last 15) < 60% with >= 6 attempts (categories from parts_image_manifest)
weakness_detection.by_confusion_pair: wrong option chosen belongs to confusable_with of the correct part >= 2 times -> add pair to targeted drills
weakness_detection.report: weekly summary with top 3 weak skills, top 5 weak categories, top 10 lapsed terms

adaptive_quiz.difficulty_targeting: choose difficulty so that expected correctness is 70-80%; difficulty = clamp(round(skill_score/20), 1, 5) +/- 1
adaptive_quiz.type_selection: weight types by inverse skill score; at least 3 different types per quiz

lesson_review.action: mark lesson 'recommended_review' and queue its weakest terms in SRS

exam.composition: equal share per skill, difficulty centered on the level, no hints, items not seen in last 7 days

retake.after_2_fails: 3 targeted remediation sessions on weakest categories before 3rd attempt

level_progression.demotion: none; show 'level health' warning after 30 days inactive and schedule refresh quiz
level_progression.fast_track: score >= 95% on a level's exam without prior lessons allows skipping that level's lessons (terms still enter SRS)

anti_gaming: Limit XP from repeated games to daily cap
Exam questions never reused within 7 days
Typing answers normalized; no partial credit for blank
needs_review_fa: مقادیر عددی آستانه‌ها باید با داده‌های واقعی کاربران کالیبره شود (A/B test).
الگوریتم placement با داده آزمایشی اعتبارسنجی شود.
